surprises: NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W84-S1: The naming gate refuses two served-prefix literals of the OG-et-1 module as out-of-pattern S3 keys, so the cell stopped at its FIRST ACT (resolved in the code by amendment A1: no literal is typed; the templates come from the catalog rows).
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W84-S2: The order takes the partner segments from a listing AND refuses an unknown firm with zero reads; the segment set is taken from the catalog row's fork_keys firm values instead.
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W84-S3: The monthly report's newest-folder default must skip the non-month folders of the report root; a plain max over the names would select the corrections folder.

NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W84-S4: The dashboard catalog row's open item asks for a ruling before a gateway tool returns the three-firm object whole; the rollup is Opal-only admitted, so the open item stays live at merge.
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W84-S5: The lag figures come from the hardcoded NYSE fallback calendar on this runtime (pandas_market_calendars absent); the fallback covers 2010 to 2027.
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W84-S6: BLOCKING for the status tag only: the task-order file is outside this worker's <paths> grant, so the pending-to-complete flip is left to the issuer.
